content: DementiaBank (DB): The DementiaBank dataset is the largest available public dataset of speech for assessing cognitive impairments. It consists of narrative picture descriptions from participants aged between 45 to 90 BIBREF24 . In each sample, a participant describes the picture that they are shown. Out of the 210 participants in the study, 117 were diagnosed with AD ( INLINEFORM0 samples of speech) and 93 were healthy (HC; INLINEFORM1 samples) with many subjects repeating the task with an interval of a year. Demographics of age, sex, and years of education are provided in the dataset.
